title: MMR catch-up — test scenarios
description: Seven patient cases, plus two design variants of case 7, used to test schedule-aware classification of MMR vaccination records. Each case lists the inputs (date of birth and full vaccination history) and the expected classifier output.
dateRule: All dates are relative, so the scenarios hold in any academic year. A date of birth is a birthday and a year group in the current academic year. A vaccination is an age at vaccination (months and days after date of birth). Eligible from is date of birth plus months, or a dose plus days. The seed writes the cohort for 2025/26 and shifts it by whole years to the current academic year, so no age changes.

scheduleRules.countedOutcomesNote: Only Vaccinated records are classified. Every other outcome, including Partially vaccinated and Already had the vaccine, goes to the encounters table and never counts as a dose. An Already had the vaccine record sets the status for MMR (see case 7).
scheduleRules.statusRule: Fully vaccinated only when no doses remain. While doses remain, a given dose does not set the status; it falls through to triage and consent as for any other programme (Due vaccination, Needs triage, Has a refusal, Needs consent). Exception (known gap, case 7): an Already had the vaccine record sets Fully vaccinated for MMR whatever the dose count, as already_had does in Mavis. The prototype uses the same outcome when a previous vaccination is recorded, so recording one previous MMR vaccination also sets Fully vaccinated; in Mavis that flow records an administered dose that counts toward the schedule.
scheduleRules.eligibleFromLogic: nextSlot = validDoses.length + 1; if nextSlot > 2 then null; else max(dob + minAgeMonths[nextSlot], lastValidGiven.administeredAt + 28 days) — second term only applied when a previous valid dose exists

cases.summary: First dose given one day before the 1st birthday (11m 29d) — out of schedule by one day. The second given dose at 48m was logged as Dose 2 by the original clinician but the classifier promotes it to Dose 1, so the patient appears to still need a Dose 2. Parent has refused MMR for the catch-up session citing 'Already had both doses of the MMR vaccine'.

cases.knownGapNote: Demonstrates current behaviour, not intended behaviour. Mirrors already_had in production Mavis: a legacy marker that the child is done, now created mainly by imports (already had elsewhere). It has no dose date, skips the dose maths and gives a vaccinated status, so a vaccinated child can show 0 of 2 doses.
cases.summary: No dose records. One Already had the vaccine record imported from CHIS, dated on the import date. It fills no dose slot, but the child is marked Fully vaccinated with 0 of 2 doses complete.
